t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 2 sets of 3 gnomes that correspond to 2 colours of baskets. If you can select the correct coloured gnome to match the corresponding basket, the score is higher. Purple, pink and brown go with the brown basket, whereas green, yellow and blue go with the blue basket. The increase in score is temporary, so you need to switch your strategy every now and then.

vb_textbox.text: There doesn't seem to be any particular pattern that I could discern, however, I seemed to get more mushrooms/points when I focused on the purple, green and red gnomes. The basket colour doesn't seem to do anything. Occasionally, switching between S and K (S, K, S, K, S, K etc.) seemed to work, but only for a certain period of time. The size of the hats the gnomes were wearing didn't seem to impact the points gained either.
